title: Periodic inspection and category testing reports and notations on the inspection certificate.
officialText:
Periodic inspection and category testing reports and notations on the inspection certificate shall comply with the requirements of sections 28-304.6.4.1, 28-304.6.4.2, and 28-304.6.4.3.

(Am. L.L. 2021/126, 11/7/2021, eff. 1/1/2022; Am. L.L. 2023/077, 6/11/2023, eff. 6/11/2023)
